dedupe_keys.name: clarus ccpview cleared derivatives volumes and ccp quantitative disclosures

description: CCPView is a commercial data service that aggregates volumes and open interest of cleared derivatives across the world's central counterparties (CCPs), filterable by CCP, asset class, product and currency, and compiles the CPMI-IOSCO quantitative disclosures of CCPs, with disclosure data from September 2015 to date. It is produced by Clarus Financial Technology, which also offers SDRView, SEFView and SBSDRView for trade repository data and publishes regular blog analyses based on them, such as quarterly shares of rates derivatives CCPs and record initial margin disclosures. Coverage is global across the main clearing houses. Access is through a paid login, with demonstrations on request; no price is shown. Caveats: the harmonised view is proprietary, the counts depend on what each CCP reports, and the page read does not describe update timing or export options. For simulation it gives market share and initial margin disclosure data for models of how the failure of a clearing member or CCP could cascade through derivatives markets, a core question for financial market infrastructure resilience. It is related to the Reserve Bank of Australia retail payments reliability disclosures record in this catalogue, another source of infrastructure performance disclosures.
